## Prism 18 - Token Refresh & Health (cron, every 15 min)
Calls the Supabase Edge Function `prism-token-refresh` (see docs/SUPABASE_PRISM_V2_PROMPTS.md) which scans tokens expiring within 10 minutes and refreshes them server-side. Configure PRISM_SUPABASE_URL as an instance environment variable and the Prism Token Refresh Secret header credential (x-refresh-secret) after deploying the function. Until then the run logs a clear "not configured" note and stays green.
